scope_note: No DBMS exists in this repo; the 'data layer' is the Lamdera in-memory backend model (src/Backend.elm) with compiler-generated Evergreen state snapshots (src/Evergreen/) and migrations. In scope: src/Evergreen/, src/Types/, src/Types.elm, tests/, plus src/Backend.elm and src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm for storage and seed data.

elements.name: Lamdera backend model + Evergreen state versioning
elements.description: Single-node in-memory state store. The authoritative application state is the Lamdera backend `Model` (alias for `BackendModel`), held in the backend process and serialized by the Lamdera platform across sessions/deploys. No SQL, no ORM, no connection strings; Elm's total types mean no nullable columns exist (the only Maybe fields are Tile.cloister and FrontendModel.error).

detail.dbms: none — Lamdera in-memory backend model (platform-managed serialization; no DBMS in repo)
detail.orm: none — direct Elm value composition; no persistence abstraction layer
detail.migration_tool: Lamdera Evergreen (compiler-generated snapshot + migration files under src/Evergreen/)

elements.name: BackendModel
elements.description: Top-level persisted state record of the Lamdera backend (the `Model` alias). Algebraic type with two variants: BePlayerRegistration (lobby, players only) and BeGamePlayed (active game). Exactly one variant holds at a time; the game is dropped when the lobby is reset.

elements.name: FrontendModel
elements.description: Per-session frontend state (mirror of the backend view for one player). Algebraic type with three variants: FePlayerRegistration, FeLobby, FeGamePlayed. Persisted per Lamdera session alongside the backend model.

elements.name: Game
elements.description: The core game-state record: player scores, remaining meeples, ordered player list, current turn, the tile about to be placed, phase, last placed tile, next feature id counter, shuffled tile draw stack, the placed-tile grid, and the meeples grouped by feature.

elements.name: TileGrid
elements.description: Collection of placed tiles: a Dict keyed by board Coordinate. Grows as tiles are placed; seeded with the center Cloister tile at (0,0).

elements.name: PlayerScores
elements.description: Player score table: Dict keyed by PlayerName with Score (Int) values. Initialized to 0 per player at game start; updated at feature completion.

elements.name: Meeples
elements.description: Meeple registry grouped by feature: Dict keyed by SideId (feature id), each entry a List of Meeple on that feature. Started empty; entries are inserted when meeples are placed and removed when a feature is scored.

elements.name: Tile
elements.description: A placed or pending tile instance: its tileset id, current rotation (degrees), four cardinal sides (north/east/south/west) and an optional Cloister side reference. Rotation is normalized to [0,360) after 360000 degrees to prevent overflow.

elements.name: Side
elements.description: One side of a tile: a feature id (SideId; -1 marks a field side that does not belong to a named feature) and the Feature it borders. SideIds are renumbered globally (updateSideIds) so connected features across tiles share an id.

elements.name: Meeple
elements.description: A player's meeple: owning player index, board coordinate, and position (Center/North/East/South/West/Skip). Type comment notes room for expansion properties (large meeple, pig, ...).

elements.name: Feature
elements.description: Enum of the kinds of Carcassonne features a tile side can border.

elements.name: GameState
elements.description: Enum of the current game phase: placing a tile, placing a meeple, or finished.

elements.name: MeeplePosition
elements.description: Enum of where a meeple is placed relative to the last placed tile (or Skip to decline placement).

elements.name: Score
elements.description: Value type alias: a player's accumulated points.

elements.name: Coordinate
elements.description: Value type alias: a board grid position as an (x, y) integer pair; negative coordinates are used (grid extends in all four directions from the center).

elements.name: PlayerIndex
elements.description: Value type alias: a player's position in the turn-order array (0-based). Domain is 0..4 enforced by playerLimit = 5.

elements.name: PlayerName
elements.description: Value type alias: a player's unique display name (String). Uniqueness across the lobby is enforced at registration by List.member.

detail.domain_constraint: unique within lobby (enforced at registration, src/Backend.elm:95-101)

elements.name: players
elements.description: Registered lobby players (BePlayerRegistration variant). Max 5; duplicates rejected.

elements.name: game
elements.description: The active game (BeGamePlayed variant).

elements.name: nameInput
elements.description: Text buffer of the player-name input field (FePlayerRegistration variant).

elements.name: error
elements.description: Registration error message shown in the lobby (FePlayerRegistration variant); the one nullable-equivalent field in the frontend model.

elements.name: playerName (FeLobby)
elements.description: This session's player, once registered (FeLobby variant).

elements.name: players (FeLobby)
elements.description: Lobby player list as seen by this session (FeLobby variant).

elements.name: playerName (FeGamePlayed)
elements.description: This session's player during an active game (FeGamePlayed variant).

elements.name: debugMode
elements.description: Per-session debug rendering toggle (FeGamePlayed variant).

elements.name: game (FeGamePlayed)
elements.description: Frontend copy of the Game record (FeGamePlayed variant).

elements.name: playerScores
elements.description: Score per player, keyed by name.

elements.name: playerMeeples
elements.description: Remaining meeple count per player, keyed by name.

elements.name: players
elements.description: Ordered turn list; index doubles as PlayerIndex.

detail.constraint: 1..5 entries; must not be empty (initializeGame doc comment)

elements.name: currentPlayer
elements.description: Index of the player whose turn it is; wraps around via getNextPlayer.

elements.name: tileToPlace
elements.description: The tile currently on the table to be placed (next draw from tileDrawStack).

detail.default: getTile 0 placeholder, replaced by random shuffled draw at InitializeGame

elements.name: gameState
elements.description: Current phase of the turn.

elements.name: lastPlacedTile
elements.description: Coordinate of the most recently placed tile; basis for meeple placement and adjacency checks.

elements.name: nextSideId
elements.description: Monotonic feature-id counter; new feature SideIds are allocated from here so globally connected features keep a stable id.

detail.default: max existing SideId over grid at initializeGame

elements.name: tileDrawStack
elements.description: Shuffled remaining tile pool (List of TileId). Reshuffled via Random.List.shuffle through BackendMsg after game init and each meeple placement.

detail.constraint: 71 entries at start; empty when game is finished (finishGame on Nothing draw, src/Backend.elm:76-84)

elements.name: tileGrid
elements.description: The placed tiles on the board.

elements.name: meeples
elements.description: All placed meeples grouped by the feature (SideId) they occupy.

elements.name: tileId
elements.description: Identity of this tile's tileset definition (0..23 defined; unknown ids fall back to tile 0).

elements.name: rotation
elements.description: Current rotation in degrees (0/90/180/270); reset with modBy 360 once it reaches 360000 to avoid overflow.

elements.name: north
elements.description: North side of the tile.

elements.name: east
elements.description: East side of the tile.

elements.name: south
elements.description: South side of the tile.

elements.name: west
elements.description: West side of the tile.

elements.name: cloister
elements.description: SideId of the Cloister feature on this tile, if any (2 of the 24 tileset tiles carry one); the only nullable-equivalent field in the Game state.

elements.name: sideId
elements.description: Feature id this side belongs to; -1 marks a field-only side not part of a named feature. Ids are renumbered globally on tile placement so connected features share an id.

detail.constraint: -1 = field-only side; otherwise globally unique feature id >= nextSideId allocation

elements.name: sideFeature
elements.description: The kind of feature this side borders.

elements.name: owner
elements.description: PlayerIndex of the player who owns this meeple.

elements.name: coordinates
elements.description: Board position of the meeple.

elements.name: position
elements.description: Meeple placement position relative to the tile.

elements.name: score
elements.description: Point total (Int).

elements.name: coordinate pair
elements.description: (x, y) grid position.

elements.name: player index
elements.description: 0-based turn-order position (Int).

elements.name: player name
elements.description: Unique player name (String).

elements.name: TileGrid primary key
elements.description: TileGrid is keyed by board Coordinate; each coordinate holds at most one placed tile (Dict uniqueness).

elements.name: PlayerScores primary key
elements.description: Scores keyed by PlayerName; one Score row per player.

elements.name: Meeples primary key
elements.description: Meeple groups keyed by feature SideId; one feature id maps to its (0..N) meeples.

elements.name: playerMeeples primary key
elements.description: Remaining-meeple counts keyed by PlayerName.

elements.name: players turn-order key
elements.description: Player identity in Game is positional: the Array index (PlayerIndex, 0..4) selects a player; currentPlayer is an index into it. The name string remains the cross-record identifier.

elements.name: Tile natural key
elements.description: TileId (0..23) identifies the immutable tileset definition; getTile falls back to tile 0 for unknown ids, so every TileId is resolvable.

elements.name: PlayerName lobby key
elements.description: PlayerName is the lobby-level identity; registration rejects duplicates via List.member, and Kick targets a name.

elements.name: tileGrid lookup index
elements.description: Dict Coordinate -> Tile supports O(log n) point lookups used for neighbor adjacency checks (8-neighborhood), last-placed-tile retrieval, and feature-connectivity scans.

elements.name: meeples lookup index
elements.description: Dict SideId -> List Meeple supports feature-owner queries (getFeatureOwners) and meeple insert/removal on the last-placed tile's feature ids.

elements.name: meepleColorDictionary lookup
elements.description: Static (non-persisted) Dict PlayerIndex -> color name (0..4: red/blue/green/yellow/black) used to pick a meeple image; constant data, not part of the state record.

elements.name: BackendModel owns Game
elements.description: The BeGamePlayed variant holds exactly one active Game; BePlayerRegistration holds none. Composition: the Game exists only inside the backend model.

elements.name: BackendModel holds lobby players
elements.description: BePlayerRegistration.players is the lobby roster; capped at playerLimit (5) with LobbyIsFull on overflow.

elements.name: FrontendModel mirrors Game
elements.description: The FeGamePlayed variant mirrors the backend Game for the session (broadcasts of GameInitialized/UpdateGameState replace it).

elements.name: FrontendModel holds lobby players
elements.description: FeLobby.players mirrors the lobby roster for the session.

elements.name: Game aggregates placed Tiles (via TileGrid)
elements.description: Game.tileGrid maps each Coordinate to a Tile; one tile per coordinate, growing over the game.

elements.name: Game aggregates Meeples (via Meeples dict)
elements.description: Game.meeples maps each feature SideId to its 0..N Meeple list; total meeple count is bounded by 7 x number of players.

elements.name: Game holds one Score per player
elements.description: Game.playerScores maps each PlayerName to a Score.

elements.name: Game references players
elements.description: Game.players is the ordered roster (1..5) that currentPlayer indexes into.

elements.name: Game holds the tile to place
elements.description: Game.tileToPlace is the next drawn tile awaiting placement/rotation.

elements.name: Game has a phase
elements.description: Game.gameState selects the current phase.

elements.name: Game tracks last placed tile position
elements.description: Game.lastPlacedTile points into the TileGrid at the most recent placement.

elements.name: Game tracks current turn
elements.description: Game.currentPlayer is a PlayerIndex into Game.players.

elements.name: Tile composes four Sides
elements.description: Each tile has exactly four named sides (north/east/south/west); rotation permutes them rather than reordering storage.

elements.name: Tile optionally references a Cloister feature
elements.description: Tile.cloister is Maybe SideId: 0..1 cloister feature per tile (tileset tiles 3 and 4 have cloister=Just 0).

elements.name: Side belongs to a Feature kind
elements.description: Side.sideFeature classifies the feature the side borders; sideId groups sides into the same connected feature.

elements.name: Feature (SideId) groups Meeples
elements.description: The Meeples dict groups 0..N meeples under the SideId of the feature they occupy; getFeatureOwners reports distinct owners per feature id.

elements.name: Meeple has a position
elements.description: Meeple.position is its placement relative to a tile.

elements.name: Meeple sits at a Coordinate
elements.description: Meeple.coordinates is its board position.

elements.name: Meeple owned by a player
elements.description: Meeple.owner is the PlayerIndex of its owner; each player starts with 7 meeples (playerMeeples).

elements.name: Tileset (24 unique tiles)
elements.description: Hand-written tileset data: getTile defines tile ids 0..23 (each with 4 sides and optional cloister); unknown ids fall back to tile 0. This is the immutable reference data behind every Tile instance.

elements.name: Tile draw stack composition
elements.description: initializeDrawStack builds the 71-tile shuffled pool: 3x tile0, 9x tile1, 8x tile2, 4x tile3, 2x tile4, 1x tile5, 3x tile6, 1x tile7, 1x tile8, 2x tile9, 3x tile10, 5x tile11, 3x tile12, 2x tile13, 2x tile14, 1x tile15, 2x tile16, 3x tile17, 2x tile18, 3x tile19, 3x tile20, 3x tile21, 4x tile22, 1x tile23. Shuffled via Random.List.shuffle at game start and after each meeple placement.

detail.purpose: initial shuffled tile pool for a game
detail.counts: 71 tile instances across 24 unique tile ids

elements.name: Starting tile grid
elements.description: The board starts with a single tile: the center Cloister (tile id 0) at coordinate (0,0).

elements.name: initializeGame defaults
elements.description: Fresh game state: 0 score and 7 meeples per player, currentPlayer 0, phase PlaceTileState, lastPlacedTile (0,0), nextSideId from grid max, empty meeples dict; tileToPlace is a getTile 0 placeholder replaced by the first random draw.

detail.purpose: initial Game record per new game

elements.name: Backend initial state
elements.description: The backend starts in the lobby: BePlayerRegistration with an empty player list.

elements.name: Meeple color table
elements.description: Static player-index-to-color mapping (0=red, 1=blue, 2=green, 3=yellow, 4=black; unknown -> black) used for meeple image rendering.

elements.name: V1 snapshot (lobby only)
elements.description: Historical state shape at Evergreen version 1: only the player lobby existed (FePlayerRegistration/FeLobby on the frontend; BePlayerRegistration on the backend). No Game/Tile/Feature/GameState types; BackendMsg was only ClientConnected + NoOpBackendMsg; ToFrontend carried lobby updates only.

elements.name: V1 -> V3 (ModelReset)
elements.description: Compiler-generated migration that resets both models (ModelReset) and ignores all old messages (MsgOldValueIgnored for all 6 Lamdera core types) — no data was carried over from V1. The V3 snapshot added the entire game domain: Game/Tile/Side/Feature/GameState types, FeGamePlayed and BeGamePlayed model variants, ToBackend InitializeGame/RotateTileLeft/PlaceTile, and ToFrontend GameInitialized/UpdateGameState.

detail.data_migration: ModelReset (both FrontendModel and BackendModel); MsgOldValueIgnored for FrontendMsg/ToBackend/BackendMsg/ToFrontend

elements.name: V3 snapshot (name-based players, Bool cloister)
elements.description: Historical Game shape: players as List PlayerName, currentPlayer as PlayerName, lastPlayedTile as Maybe Coordinate, meeples as MeepleGrid (Dict Coordinate Meeple{owner:PlayerName}); Tile carried hasCloister: Bool; GameState = PlaceTile|PlaceMeeple|Finished; Feature = City|Road|Field (no NoFeature).

elements.name: V3 -> V5 (field-level, ModelUnchanged)
elements.description: Compiler-generated migration preserving both models (ModelUnchanged) with field-level mappings: Game (migrate_Types_Game_Game), TileGrid via Dict.map, Tile/Side, Feature, GameState, and the four message types (MsgMigrated). The Game and Tile record shapes are unchanged V3 -> V5; the snapshot diff adds TerminateGame messages: FeTerminateGame, ToBackend TerminateGame, and ToFrontend JoinedGame + GameTerminated.

detail.data_migration: ModelUnchanged + MsgMigrated (field-by-field: Game, TileGrid, Side, Tile, Feature, GameState, FrontendMsg, ToBackend, ToFrontend)

elements.name: V5 snapshot (pre-index players)
elements.description: Historical Game shape: identical records to V3 (List players, PlayerName currentPlayer, Maybe lastPlayedTile, MeepleGrid), Tile.hasCloister: Bool, Feature = City|Road|Field, GameState = PlaceTile|PlaceMeeple|Finished.

elements.name: V5 -> V10 (ModelReset; meeple model redesign)
elements.description: Compiler-generated migration that resets both models (ModelReset) and ignores all old messages — no V5 game data survived. Snapshot diff V5 -> V10 is the largest redesign: Game.players List -> Array; new playerMeeples (Dict PlayerName Int, 7/player); currentPlayer PlayerName -> PlayerIndex; lastPlayedTile Maybe Coordinate -> lastPlacedTile Coordinate (non-null); meepleGrid Dict Coordinate Meeple{owner:PlayerName} -> meeples Dict SideId (List Meeple{owner:PlayerIndex, coordinates, position}) — meeples now keyed by feature id; Tile.hasCloister Bool -> cloister Maybe SideId; GameState constructors renamed PlaceTile/PlaceMeeple/Finished -> PlaceTileState/PlaceMeepleState/FinishedState; Feature gained NoFeature; new MeeplePosition enum and Score/PlayerIndex/Coordinate value modules; FeGamePlayed gained debugMode; FrontendMsg gained FeKillLobby/ChangeDebugMode/FePlaceMeeple; ToBackend gained KillLobby/PlaceMeeple; BackendMsg NoOpBackendMsg replaced by InitializeGameAndTileDrawStackShuffled/TileDrawStackShuffled; ToFrontend gained LobbyIsFull/LobbyKilled.

detail.data_migration: ModelReset (both FrontendModel and BackendModel); MsgOldValueIgnored for FrontendMsg/ToBackend/BackendMsg/ToFrontend

gaps: Exact persistence medium is not verifiable from this repo: there is no lamdera/platform directory or store config; 'the Lamdera platform serializes the backend model across sessions/deploys' is stated in the planner scope note and implied by the Evergreen headers (src/Evergreen/Migrate/V10.elm:3,18) and the lamdera/core + lamdera/codecs dependencies (elm.json:13-14), but the concrete storage backend (Lamdera Cloud vs local) is unverified.

No security/compliance mechanisms exist in the data layer: no authentication beyond player-name uniqueness (src/Backend.elm:95-101), no authorization rules, no audit log, no encryption-at-rest configuration. PII exposure is limited to free-form player names (PlayerName = String, src/Types/PlayerName.elm:4-5). Absence verified by full-file scan of src/ and tests/.

Planner scope note claims a '74-tile tileset'; the code defines 24 unique tile definitions (ids 0..23, src/Helpers/TileMapper.elm:9-253) and a 71-entry draw stack (src/Types/Game.elm:120-147). The code's own numbers (24 / 71) are modeled; the '74' figure is unverified.

The live model (src/Types.elm) has drifted past the latest V10 snapshot without a new snapshot in the repo: NoOpBackendMsg (present in src/Evergreen/V10/Types.elm:66) and ClearError (present in src/Evergreen/V10/Types.elm:47) no longer exist in the current BackendMsg (src/Types.elm:61-64) / FrontendMsg (src/Types.elm:36-47). No V11 migration exists, so these post-V10 deletions are unversioned in the repo.

on_delete / referential-action semantics are inapplicable: Elm has no database; all 'foreign keys' are value composition with no runtime referential enforcement (e.g. Meeple.owner is an index with no bounds check at the type level).

Column 'defaults' for the Game record are runtime initializers from initializeGame (src/Types/Game.elm:53-73), not storage-layer defaults; tileToPlace's documented placeholder (getTile 0) is always overwritten by the first shuffled draw (src/Backend.elm:44-59, comment at src/Types/Game.elm:65-66).
